etymologies.etymologyHTML: From a- +‎ head. Perhaps originally a nautical term, "beyond the head (of a ship)", then drifting into more general English usage where it is used to describe something as being "in front of".

definitions.definition: At or towards the front; in the direction one is facing or moving.
So as to be further advanced, either spatially or in an abstract sense; to be superior.
